Theorem
[John--Nirenberg estimate] 1. ch7:7.21\group ch07-sobolev-spacesSource: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0178 Let $\Omega $ be convex and $u\in W^{1,1}(\Omega )$. Suppose \begin{equation} \tag {7.51} \int _{\Omega \cap B_R}|Du|\, dx\leq KR^{n-1} \end{equation} for every ball $B_R$. There are $\sigma _0,C>0$, depending only on $n$, such that \begin{equation} \tag {7.52} \int _\Omega \exp \! \left(\frac\sigma K|u-u_\Omega |\right)dx \leq C(\diam \Omega )^n, \qquad \sigma =\sigma _0|\Omega |(\diam \Omega )^{-n}. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Lemma 7.16 bounds $|u-u_\Omega |$ by a constant multiple of $V_{1/n}|Du|$. Apply Lemma 7.20 with the Morrey bound (7.51).

□
